unitAndQuantityRules.rule: Attach the unit to observation components and residual scores under the locked case.
Q columns are direction coefficients across compatible calibrated channels.
Always label as case-specific teaching tolerance.
Never present as a universal machine-fault threshold.
State the matrix, preprocessing and k beside the percentage.

semanticStyleRules: Use 'không gian con tuyến tính' when affine confusion is possible.
Use exact membership symbol ∈ only for exact statements; use near-subspace prose or ε for approximate statements.
Use lowercase bold symbols for vectors and uppercase bold symbols for matrices where renderer support is available.
Keep transpose attached to the complete matrix symbol.
Use P_U for the orthogonal projector and do not reuse P for an unrelated transform in the same context.
Keep Q^TQ=I adjacent to every first use of QQ^T or Q^Ty.
Keep full-column-rank condition adjacent to every first use of the general projector.
Use 'tâm hóa' for subtracting μ; do not call it normalization.
Always state samples-as-rows when discussing X_c and reduced SVD shapes.
Write floating-point rank, numerical rank and retained dimension as separate labelled results.
Keep residual vector r distinct from scalar score ||r||₂.
Use 'poorly represented by the current model' rather than a fault label.
Do not introduce an unversioned threshold or model artifact.
forbiddenNormalizations: Do not rewrite x=μ+Qz+ε as x=Qz when the affine offset matters.
Do not replace the general projector with BB^T.
Do not remove the tolerance from rank_τ.
Do not rename γ_demo as a fault threshold.
Do not round locked values in stored canonical fields.
Do not merge centering, scaling and vector normalization into one label.
Do not convert a bounded model-fit statement into a causal diagnosis.

globalRules: One primary mathematical claim per formula block.
Meaning, conditions and warning remain adjacent to the formula they qualify.
Do not split matrix rows, transpose marks or inverse exponents across semantic blocks.
Examples separate setup, calculation, result, invariant check and interpretation.
Rank tables keep matrix, orientation, criterion and result in the same visible group.
Residual vector and residual score must not be visually merged into one object.
Case-specific thresholds must display their teaching-only label.
No semantic block may contain UI or runtime instructions.
